verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs directly describe faceted navigation with live counts (e.g., 'Color: Red (12), Blue (8)'), filtering by categories/ranges/attributes (brand, color, size, price range), a dedicated facet search endpoint for large facet lists, and this all being returned from a single query/API call alongside search results. Community evidence corroborates real-world use of filtering/faceting features at scale. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark specifically validating live facet counts performance/accuracy at scale.
